name: generic-androidtv
description: Conservative defaults for any Android TV or Google TV device. It removes no packages, changes no system setting, and only limits background work for common streaming apps.

background_restrict.why: Stops the streaming app from starting itself at power-on or running while you use something else. It still opens normally.
Same as above for Prime Video.
Same as above for YouTube, including its recommendations service.

notes: Generic profile: nothing here has been tested on a particular model. Run 'plan' first and read every line.
Android 11 does not let adb disable another app's boot receiver. Background restriction is the supported way to stop auto-start.
